Loop Detection: Triggered when the action repetition ratio or state repetition crosses defined thresholds.
Timeout/Step Limit: Absolute maximum time or number of actions allowed per test run.
The judge terminates the run due to crossing loop thresholds, identifying severe erratic modifications, or chaotic task abandonment.
Implementing strict step limits and early termination conditions in the judge is critical to managing costs.
